title: Log a contact and the next step

steps.do: Contacts tab → "＋ Log a contact": How = Telephone call, Which way = We contacted them, When = today, Who you spoke to "Ravi", What was said "Wants revised rate", How it went "Positive", Time it took = 15 minutes, Next thing to do "Send revised rate", By when = tomorrow → "Save this contact".
steps.expect: You land back on the Contacts tab. The list shows it at the top: 📞 Telephone call · we contacted them · with Ravi · "Positive" · today · you; "Wants revised rate"; ⏱ 15 minutes · ➜ Next: Send revised rate — by tomorrow. The lead shows Next: Send revised rate by tomorrow (owner, 12 Nov 2026: every contact as a list, with its details).
steps.observed: "Logged. The next step is on the lead." On the Contacts tab: "📞 Telephone call ⭢ we contacted them with Ravi Positive 15 Nov 2026 · Test MktExec Wants revised rate ⏱ 15 minutes ➜ Next: Send revised rate — by 16 Nov 2026". The lead shows Next: Send revised rate (16 Nov 2026).

steps.do: Log a second contact (an e-mail, they contacted us, no next step).
steps.expect: It appears above the first; each keeps its own details. History → "What's happened" lists both, with the time taken and the next step.
steps.observed: The e-mail is above the call, each with its own details. History: "15 Nov 2026 Telephone call ⭢ out Ravi Positive Wants revised rate ⏱ 15 minutes · ➜ Next: Send revised rate — by 16 Nov 2" and "15 Nov 2026 E-mail ⭠ in Ravi Asked us to email Sent drawings Test MktExec".

steps.expect: The lead shows as overdue on the Leads board and in "Your next actions" on the Sales home.
steps.observed: Board: "1 lead need attention"; Sales home "Your next actions" lists TB Contact Log Co (due 14 Nov 2026).
steps.note: The robot set "By when" to yesterday on the lead's details form (Actions → Edit the details).
